title: Quarrow Motors recalls 80,000 electric cars over a software flaw

facts.f01: Quarrow Motors is recalling 80,000 electric cars
facts.f02: A software flaw can cut power to the motors while driving
facts.f04: A free over-the-air update fixes it
facts.f05: The flaw is linked to 3 minor crashes
facts.f06: About 6,000 cars need a dealer visit for the fix
facts.f07: Quarrow expects the recall to cost $9 million
facts.f08: A false overheating reading triggers the shutdown
facts.f09: It only happens when the battery is below -10 °C
facts.f10: The update cross-checks a second temperature sensor
facts.f11: The Office of Vehicle Safety began investigating in August
facts.f12: Owner letters go out starting January 8

byteward.title: Quarrow Motors recalls 80,000 electric cars over a software flaw
byteward.author: Dana Whitlock
body: [f01: Quarrow Motors is recalling 80,000 electric cars.] [f02: The company says a software flaw can cut power to the motors while the car is moving.]
[f03: The recall covers Pavane SUVs from the 2025 and 2026 model years.] [f04: Quarrow will fix the problem with a free over-the-air update.]

[f05: The company says it knows of three minor crashes linked to the flaw.] A sudden loss of power is one of the more dangerous failures a car can have, especially at highway speeds. Owners will want that update quickly.

launch-desk.title: Quarrow Motors recalls 80,000 electric cars over software flaw
launch-desk.author: Theo Marsh
body: [f01: Quarrow Motors is recalling 80,000 of its electric cars.] [f04: The fix is a free over-the-air update.] [f06: Roughly 6,000 cars will have to visit a dealer instead.]
[f07: Quarrow expects the recall to cost about $9 million.] That's small money for a carmaker, but recalls rarely help sales. Investors will be watching December deliveries.

ohm-and-bit.title: Quarrow Motors recalls 80,000 EVs over a software flaw
ohm-and-bit.author: Rafe Okonkwo-Hart
body: [f02: The flaw behind Quarrow's recall can cut power to the motors while the car is moving.] [f08: It starts with a false overheating reading from a battery temperature sensor, which makes the battery controller shut off power to protect the pack.]
[f09: According to Quarrow, it only happens when the battery is colder than -10 °C.] Cold weather is exactly when a driver can least afford a car that stops.
[f10: The update makes the controller check a second temperature sensor before it cuts power.] [f06: About 6,000 early cars have older modems that can't download it, so they'll need a dealer visit.]

bench-and-bill.title: Quarrow Motors recalls 80,000 electric cars after a safety investigation
bench-and-bill.author: Owen Brightwater
body: [f01: Quarrow Motors filed a recall covering 80,000 electric cars with the Office of Vehicle Safety on Monday.] [f11: The office had been investigating the problem since August.]
[f09: The filing says the power loss only occurs when the battery is below -10 °C.] [f07: In a separate filing to investors, Quarrow estimated the recall's cost at $9 million.]
[f12: Owner notification letters will go out starting January 8.] Until then, owners in cold climates should watch for the update.

wirefold.title: Quarrow Motors recalls 80,000 electric cars
body: Quarrow Motors is recalling 80,000 electric cars because a software flaw can cut power to the motors, the company said Monday.
